signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: An account lets you play public games, block players and keep a history of your games.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.lead: Free, no ads. Your e-mail address is never shown to other players.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A phrase of several words is ideal.
signUp.displayNameHint: 2 to 20 characters, shown to other players. Can be changed once a month.
signUp.conduct: By creating an account, you agree to treat other players with respect.

welcome.title: Choose your player name
welcome.lead: It is the only name other players will see.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail address
verify.lead: Confirm that this address is yours.
verify.doneLead: Thank you! You can play public games.
verify.invalidLead: This link was already used or is more than 24 hours old. Ask for a new one from your profile.
verify.sent: A verification link was just sent to {email}.
verify.pending: Your e-mail address is not verified yet.
verify.required: Verify your e-mail address to play public games.

mail.verifyBody:
Hello {name},

To confirm your e-mail address, open this link (valid for 24 hours):
{link}

If you did not create an account, ignore this message.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.emailInvalid: This e-mail address is not valid.
errors.emailTaken: An account already exists with this address. Sign in instead.
errors.name_length: The name must be 2 to 20 characters long.
errors.name_characters: Letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, dots and apostrophes only (not at the start or the end).
errors.name_reserved: This name is reserved, choose another one.
errors.ageRequired: You must be 15 or older to create an account.
errors.oauthAccountNotLinked: This Google account cannot be linked to this account.
errors.oauthFailed: Signing in with Google failed. Try again.
errors.name_offensive: This name is not accepted, please choose another one.
errors.emailBarred: This e-mail address cannot create an account for now.

password.tooLong: This password is too long (72 bytes at most).
password.tooCommon: This password is too common, choose another one.
password.matchesEmail: The password must not contain your e-mail address.
